title: Solution Design Specialist / Senior Specialist
desc:
Ekol, an integrated logistics company founded in 1990, provides warehousing, domestic distribution, foreign trade, and supply chain management services.
Ekol’s business model is bolstered by technological inspiration. It blends mind, heart, and awareness while constantly offering customers integrated, interconnected, and innovative solutions. Ekol is always one step ahead and never settles for good enough. This boosts our customers' accomplishments and creates environmental, financial, and social benefits. Ekol is one of Europe's major logistics providers, boasting distribution centers with 775.000 square meters of total indoor space in Turkey and Ukraine.
In fulfilling its promises, Ekol derives its greatest strength from its workforce and its powerful distribution network. A multinational team of 5,000 staff members, wholly dedicated to delivering impeccable customer satisfaction, plays a vital role in Ekol’s success story.
We are looking for new colleagues as “Solution Design Specialist” in İstanbul/Anatolian Side accordance with the following criteria for our company.
About Ekol
As one of Türkiye's leading contract logistics providers, we combine engineering expertise, operational excellence, and digital innovation to deliver high-performing warehouse and intralogistics solutions across a wide range of industries.
We are looking for a Solution Design Specialist / Senior Specialist to join our Engineering Team, where engineering, technology, and business collaborate to design the next generation of logistics solutions.
Role Purpose
As a Solution Design Specialist / Senior Specialist, you will play a key role in designing innovative, efficient, and commercially competitive warehousing solutions for both prospective customers and existing operations.
You will translate business requirements into scalable operating concepts by designing conventional and automated warehouse solutions, evaluating intralogistics technologies and investment alternatives, and performing warehouse design, resource planning, cost modelling, and feasibility analyses.
Working closely with Sales, Operations, Engineering, and other cross-functional stakeholders, you will develop practical, value-driven solutions that balance customer expectations, operational excellence, and commercial objectives.
Key Responsibilities
Design end-to-end conventional and automated warehousing solutions for new business opportunities, customer tenders, and commercial proposals.
Assess intralogistics technologies and evaluate alternative operating models to identify the most suitable solutions for each project.
Design warehouse layouts, material flows, and operational processes to optimize productivity, scalability, and cost efficiency.
Prepare detailed operational resource plans, including workforce, equipment, and storage capacity requirements.
Develop operational cost models, pricing calculations, financial analyses, and business cases to support commercial decision-making.
Conduct feasibility studies and partner with Operations teams to validate solution viability and support successful implementation.
Provide technical leadership throughout the solution development process in close collaboration with the Sales team.
Prepare high-quality technical documentation, reports, and executive-level customer presentations.
What We're Looking For
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, preferably Industrial Engineering.
1–4 years of experience in warehouse operations, logistics, supply chain, solution design or a related field..
Understanding of warehouse operations, process design, operational planning, and resource optimization.
Experience in cost modelling, feasibility analysis, operational engineering, or resource planning is an advantage.
Strong analytical thinking, quantitative reasoning, and structured problem-solving skills.
Ability to analyse operational data and translate insights into practical, customer-focused solutions.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the Microsoft Office suite.
Excellent command of written and spoken English.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
Proactive, self-motivated, detail-oriented, and committed to continuous learning and professional development.
Preferred Qualifications
Familiarity with warehouse layout and process design tools such as AutoCAD, Microsoft Visio, or similar applications.
Familiarity with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or Python) is a strong plus.
Exposure to warehouse automation and intralogistics technologies.
Experience supporting customer proposals, tenders, RFPs, or logistics solution development projects.
Why Join Ekol?
Join one of Türkiye's leading contract logistics providers and help shape the future of warehouse and intralogistics solutions.
Work on large-scale, high-impact warehouse design, automation, and supply chain transformation projects.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across Engineering, Operations, Sales, and Technology.
Accelerate your professional growth through challenging projects, continuous learning, and clear career development opportunities.
Take ownership of innovative solutions that create measurable value for customers and make a tangible impact on the future of logistics.
